Under MoHFW Recruitment 2026, the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (Government of India) is filling five (05) Consultant posts on contract in the Integrated Finance Division (IFD) of the Department of Health & Family Welfare. Only retired Central Government servants at the level of Deputy Secretary or equivalent can apply. Applicants must send their particulars in the enclosed application format, with a copy of the PPO and LPC, to the Under Secretary (Establishment – II), DoH&FW, Kartavya Bhavan – 1, New Delhi. The deadline is within one (01) month from the date of issue of Circular No. Z-28015/16/2022-Estt.II, dated 30 September 2026.
The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification, the application fee or the selection process.
The Ministry of Health and Family Welfare is a ministry of the Government of India. The Establishment – II Section of its Department of Health and Family Welfare issued this circular from Kartavya Bhavan-1, New Delhi-110001. The Consultants will work in the Department's Integrated Finance Division (IFD), which handles budget matters, financial concurrence and the scrutiny of financial proposals.
Applicants who can join immediately when called may submit their particulars in the application format enclosed with the circular. They must attach a copy of their PPO and LPC and send the application within one (01) month from the date of issue of the circular. The application must be addressed to:
Under Secretary (Establishment – II), DoH&FW, Work Hall No. 11049, 'A' Wing, First Floor, Kartavya Bhavan – 1, New Delhi – 110001
The application format is titled "Application Format for Appointment as Consultant in IFD, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare". It asks for the following details:
Position applied for, name, father's/husband's name, date of birth and Aadhar number
Date of retirement, the Ministry/Department you retired from and the designation you last held
Last pay drawn (Basic), with copies of the PPO and LPC enclosed
Telephone number, mobile number and e-mail ID
Work experience in a table: Organization/Institute, Period (From – To), Nature of work and Remarks (add a separate sheet if needed)
Place, date and signature under the declaration
The circular is signed by Amit Kumar Sharma, Under Secretary to the Govt. of India (Tele: 011-24013259). The circular was sent to NIC, MoH&FW, for publishing on the MoH&FW website, and to the Under Secretary (CS.I) for publishing on the DoP&T website. It was also sent to the e-Office notice board and the notice board.
There are five (05) posts, all titled Consultants for IFD, DoH&FW. All five carry the same terms:
Eligibility: Retired Government servants at the level of Deputy Secretary or equivalent. The circular is addressed to retired Central Government servants.
Educational qualification: The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. The application format only asks applicants to state their educational qualification.
Experience: Substantive experience in handling budget matters, financial concurrence, scrutiny of financial proposals and e-Office file routing within an IFD setting.
Age limit: Maximum 63 years of age as on the date of this circular (the circular is dated 30.09.2026).
Availability: Applicants should be in a position to join immediately when called.
The official notification gives the full eligibility for the Consultant post in Annexure I and Annexure II.
The Consultant will be paid a consolidated remuneration worked out as last pay drawn minus pension, subject to TDS etc.
The remuneration for a month's services is paid in the following month.
No other allowances are permitted except TA/DA on official tours. The TA/DA entitlement is the same as the Consultant had at the time of retirement.
The Ministry will not provide any medical facility. The remuneration is deemed to include an element to cover the cost of medical cover, if any.
The contract is for a maximum period of one year in the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare and can be extended as required.
Either side can end the service by giving one month's notice.
Annexure I lists these key responsibilities for the Consultants in IFD, DoH&FW:
Scrutinizing expenditure and financial sanction proposals with reference to GFR/DFPR.
Examining Annual Accounts, financial statements and draft resolutions.
Assisting in budget preparation, re-appropriations and monitoring of expenditure.
Tendering financial advice on procurement, contract management and audit paras.
The Consultant will also perform the services assigned by the controlling officer.
Application in the enclosed format, completed and signed
A recent passport-size photograph fixed on the application format
A separate sheet for work experience, if the space on the form is not enough
The normal working hours are 9.00 am to 5.30 p.m., Monday to Friday, with a 30-minute lunch break from 1.00 p.m. to 1.30 p.m.
In special circumstances, the Consultant could be called for duty on holidays or beyond normal working hours.
The Consultant earns 1.5 days of leave for every completed month of service. Leave can be taken only with prior permission.
The Ministry of Health & Family Welfare has the right to examine and review the Consultant's services. The Consultant must work with all necessary skills, diligence, efficiency and economy.
The Ministry will not be responsible for any loss, accident, damage or injury the Consultant suffers in or out of the execution of the work, including travel.
During the term of service, the Consultant must not take part in any private business or professional activity that could conflict with the interest of the Government.
All official information must be kept confidential and used only to perform the services.
Under the declaration on the form, withholding information or giving false information will result in refusal to hire, termination of employment or a civil penalty.

Q1. How many vacancies are there in MoHFW Recruitment 2026 for Consultants?
There are five (05) Consultant vacancies. All of them are in the Integrated Finance Division (IFD) of the Department of Health & Family Welfare.
Q2. What is the last date to apply for the MoHFW Consultant posts?
Applications must be submitted within one (01) month from the date of issue of Circular No. Z-28015/16/2022-Estt.II. The circular is dated 30 September 2026 and has a handwritten "Issued 05/10/2026" endorsement.
Q3. Who can apply for the MoHFW Consultant posts?
Retired Central Government servants at the level of Deputy Secretary or equivalent can apply. They need substantive experience in handling budget matters, financial concurrence, scrutiny of financial proposals and e-Office file routing within an IFD setting.
Q4. What is the age limit for MoHFW Consultants?
The maximum age is 63 years as on the date of the circular, which is dated 30 September 2026.
Q5. How is the pay of a retired employee fixed for the MoHFW Consultant post?
The Consultant gets a consolidated remuneration worked out as last pay drawn minus pension, subject to TDS etc. Each month's remuneration is paid in the following month.
Q6. Are any allowances paid on top of the remuneration?
The only allowance is TA/DA on official tours, at the entitlement the Consultant had at retirement. No medical facility is provided, because the remuneration is deemed to include an element for medical cover.
Q7. How do I apply for MoHFW Recruitment 2026 for Consultants?
Fill in the enclosed application format and fix a recent passport-size photograph on it. Attach a copy of your PPO and LPC, and send it to the Under Secretary (Establishment – II), DoH&FW, Work Hall No. 11049, 'A' Wing, First Floor, Kartavya Bhavan – 1, New Delhi – 110001.
Q8. Is the MoHFW Consultant job permanent?
No, the engagement is on contract basis for a maximum period of one year and can be extended as required. Either side can end it by giving one month's notice.
Q9. What are the working hours for MoHFW Consultants?
The normal working hours are 9.00 am to 5.30 p.m., Monday to Friday, with a lunch break from 1.00 p.m. to 1.30 p.m. In special circumstances, Consultants could be called on holidays or beyond these hours.
